Definition: contraction for G5124 and G2076; that is:--that is (to say).
BiblicalUsage: That is to say — the word explains what has just been said. Mark says the disciples ate with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen hands, and Paul says, I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwelleth no good thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little explanation is the whole point of the word: it pauses the sentence to make sure the reader understands, and both times what it explains is the heart of the matter.
